Welcome to Anaagat Humanpower

A complete HR and workforce services partner

Anaagat Humanpower helps businesses hire, deploy, pay and stay compliant with their workforce. As the parent company of RecruitKr, we cover the full employee cycle, from finding the right person to paying them correctly every month.

Whether you need 5 people next week or 500 across locations, you work with one team that owns the outcome.

Our company

Building the workforce of tomorrow, today

Every engagement starts with a conversation. We sit with your team to understand roles, shifts, budgets and compliance needs before we hire a single person.

Who we are

Anaagat (अनागत) means “that which is yet to come”, the future.

We are a workforce solutions company and the parent of RecruitKr. Our motto, Worshiping Work, means treating every placement with respect, for the employer and for the worker.

What we do

  • Payroll processing and statutory compliance
  • Staffing and contract manpower
  • Workforce deployment at client sites
  • Permanent recruitment through RecruitKr

Why choose us

  • One team for hiring, deployment and payroll
  • Screened, document-verified people
  • Quick replacements so work doesn't stop
  • Transparent cost sheets, no hidden charges
Meet our founder

Sachin Kumar

Founder & Director, Anaagat Humanpower · Founder, RecruitKr

Sachin Kumar founded Anaagat Humanpower to give businesses one dependable partner for hiring, deploying, paying and managing their workforce. Under his leadership the group also built RecruitKr, its recruitment brand for permanent, bulk and campus hiring.

His approach is captured in the company's motto, Worshiping Work: respect for the employer who depends on every hire, and for every person whose livelihood a job supports. Through hiring drives, campus seminars and employer partnerships, he works to connect talent with opportunity.

Hiring drives & seminars

Connecting talent with opportunity, on the ground

We run hiring drives, campus seminars and career guidance sessions where young people, including young women entering the workforce, meet recruiters directly, learn about roles and get job-ready.

Empowering young women and youth

Through career guidance sessions at training institutes and colleges, we help young people, especially young women, understand job opportunities, prepare for interviews and take their first step into stable, dignified work.

Principles of our work

What we stand for

01.

Client-first approach

We start from your business need, not from a fixed package, and stay accountable until the role is filled and running.

02.

Integrity and compliance

Every worker is paid correctly with PF and ESIC. Every register and return is filed on time.

03.

Respect for work

Fair wages, safe workplaces and honest communication for the people we place. That is what Worshiping Work means.

Careers

Looking for a job? Work with Anaagat.

When we place you with a company, you are on our payroll. Your salary, PF and ESIC are handled properly from day one.

Salary on time

Paid to your bank account on a fixed date, with a monthly payslip.

PF and ESIC

Provident fund and medical insurance for you and your family.

No placement fee

We never charge job seekers any money to get a job.

Freshers welcome

Many roles need no experience. Training is given on the job.

Jobs across sectors

Factory, warehouse, delivery, security, retail, office and hotel roles.

Documents to keep ready

Aadhaar, PAN, bank passbook, 2 photos, certificates and UAN if any.
